units.function: One-off CLI database backup wrapper selecting external/embedded connection, destination, retention and filename prefix.
units.dependencyDirection: CLI/config/environment inputs feed the already-audited @paperclipai/db backup library; UI and JSON output expose its result.
units.keyDataModels: Database connection source, backup directory, tiered retention policy, filename prefix and backup file/size/prune result.
units.lifecycle: Resolve config/connection/destination, run a gzip SQL backup, prune by policy and print human or nominal JSON output.
units.testAssessment: No focused CLI test exists in the reviewed CLI test tree. Actual backup/restore mechanics were previously covered within the completed package:db unit, but CLI JSON purity, option validation, failure codes and restore workflow are not proven.
units.designRationale: Expose the shared backup engine for operators and pre-update safeguards without duplicating database logic.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs encrypted, verifiable, profile-aware backups tied to schema/app versions and a rehearsed restore path before releases or destructive changes.
units.companyOsFit: REFERENCE_ONLY. Keep the thin-wrapper principle, but define a BackupPort operation/resource with ID, checksum, encryption/key reference, consistency point, schema/app version, retention/location and stable outcomes; add symmetric restore and verification commands.
units.responsibilityConflict: The full-company data export is not bound to an accountable operator, data-export approval, destination contract or immutable evidence, and absolute paths are returned as the primary identity.
evidence: existing completed package:db evidence includes backup-lib.ts:10-1030
CLI tree search found no db restore command

units.function: Authorization and platform-floor tests for manually triggering a server database backup.
units.dependencyDirection: Injected actor and backup service exercise the real Express route/error middleware over Supertest.
units.keyDataModels: Board/Agent actor, instance-admin/local-implicit/cloud-tenant source, backup result and conflict/platform error.
units.lifecycle: Authorize, apply cloud-managed floor, trigger once, return backup metadata or conflict/forbidden response.
units.testAssessment: Approved unsandboxed focused Vitest passed 7/7 with PAPERCLIP_HOME isolated under /private/tmp. The initial runs exposed import-time user-home logging and sandbox TCP coupling. Data integrity, audit/approval, rate/CSRF/idempotency, restore and adversarial actors remain uncovered.
units.designRationale: Let self-hosted instance operators create backups while reserving managed-cloud backup ownership for the platform.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS must separate customer/platform backup responsibilities across deployment profiles and govern full-instance exports.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the explicit platform floor and Agent denial tests. Add profile contracts, step-up human auth, data-export approval, idempotent operation resources, stable codes, evidence and restore/verification scenarios.
units.responsibilityConflict: Local implicit board access can export the full instance without a named accountable human, approval, destination policy or evidence chain.
evidence: 2026-08-18 approved unsandboxed focused Vitest with isolated PAPERCLIP_HOME: 7/7 passed

units.function: Single manual full-instance backup POST endpoint guarded by instance-admin and managed-cloud policy.
units.dependencyDirection: HTTP actor and environment-derived cloud profile gate an injected server backup service; the raw service result is returned.
units.keyDataModels: InstanceDatabaseBackupService/RunResult, manual/scheduled trigger, retention/timing/path metadata and platform error detail.
units.lifecycle: Authorize, deny cloud-managed tenants, synchronously await a manual backup and return 201.
units.testAssessment: Focused route tests pass; operation lifecycle, export governance, stable conflict/status resource and restore are absent.
units.designRationale: Keep database backup infrastructure instance-scoped rather than company-scoped and prevent managed tenants from learning platform filesystem paths.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs deployment-profile ownership and governed backup/export APIs covering independent control-plane and customer-local data stores.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT only the narrow injected service and explicit managed-cloud floor. Model backup as an asynchronous, idempotent, auditable operation with redacted projection, approval and verification/restore links.
units.responsibilityConflict: Instance-admin authorization alone does not establish data-export purpose, accountable approver, destination authorization, evidence or retention responsibility.

units.function: Filesystem-derived health projection for newest gzip SQL backup freshness/size and failure-marker state.
units.dependencyDirection: Configured directories and alert paths are synchronously enumerated/read; their metadata and first error line become internal health state.
units.keyDataModels: Stable warning codes, max age, latest backup name/path/mtime/age/size, last failure path/message and aggregate status.
units.lifecycle: Find newest .sql.gz, compare age, read newest failure marker, classify missing/stale/failure/check-error and return paths plus warnings.
units.testAssessment: Relevant integration assertions exist in the still-pending broader health test unit, so this unit does not claim them as completed evidence. Source inspection shows integrity/link/performance and future-time gaps.
units.designRationale: Surface backup freshness and external backup-to-S3 failures in the ordinary health endpoint.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs provable backup recoverability, not only file freshness, across managed-cloud and self-hosted/local enterprise profiles.
units.companyOsFit: REFERENCE_ONLY. Retain stable warning-code ideas, but health must verify signed metadata/checksum, nonzero/decompressible content, schema/app compatibility, trusted ownership/modes, replicated destination and periodic restore drills using bounded asynchronous inspection.
units.responsibilityConflict: A fresh file is not evidence of recoverability or assigned remediation ownership; paths and raw failure prose can also leak infrastructure details.
